concept.title: Networking and access for Cloud TPU VMs
concept.shortdesc: Choose the network, subnetwork and IP addressing for a TPU VM, and decide how it reaches Google APIs.

section.title: Custom network and subnetwork
section.p: By default a TPU VM uses the default network. Specify a custom network and subnetwork when you create the VM to place it in your own VPC.

section.title: External and internal IP addresses
section.p: A TPU VM gets an external IP address by default. To create one without an external IP address, use the --internal-ips flag with gcloud compute tpus queued-resources create or gcloud compute tpus tpu-vm create. With the REST API, set enable_external_ips to false in the network_config of the request body.

section.title: Private Google Access
section.p: A TPU VM without an external IP address can reach Google APIs and services through Private Google Access on its subnetwork. SSH access needs either an external IP address or Private Google Access.
